India Strengthens Ties Amid Shifting Indo-Pacific Dynamics

India is deepening its strategic partnerships in the Indo-Pacific region, with reports indicating agreements with Australia on uranium exports and a growing defense relationship. Simultaneously, China has conducted a missile test in the Pacific, drawing international concern and highlighting regional geopolitical tensions. These developments underscore a complex regional landscape where nations are navigating alliances and security concerns.
